purpose: Pięć propozycji ikony iOS NaviAstra do wyboru, bez wdrożenia

variants.name: 01-astra
variants.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: professional minimalist iOS app icon for NaviAstra, a Polish navigation app. Generate exactly ONE square icon, edge-to-edge opaque flat background, NO rounded outer corners (iOS applies its own mask), NO surrounding mockup, NO border, NO text, NO labels, NO watermark. Masterful geometric graphic design, strong distinctive silhouette readable at 40px, centered mark occupying about 58% of canvas, ample negative space. Matte flat vector-like shapes with precise optical balance. No 3D, no bevels, no glass, no glow, no lens flare, no textures, no tiny decorative details. This is a new standalone icon concept, not a sheet of variants. Concept 1 — ASTRA. Solid deep midnight navy #0B121B background. One bold abstract capital A that doubles as a forward navigation arrowhead, formed by two precisely balanced solid geometric wings. The only interior cutout is a small clean four-point north star made of negative space at the crossbar. Mark is cool off-white #F2F5F8 with one restrained violet #8B2FE0 facet on its right leg. Modern, understated, iconic; compact coherent single glyph. Flat geometry only.
